entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  Bollinger position = -8% of band -> +93 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  distance to EMA20 = -6.47% -> +39 (weight 1.8) - Price 2,253.13 vs EMA20 2,408.95
  support proximity = 2.40% away -> +40 (weight 1.4) - Support 2,199.01 (2 touches) - better risk/reward, conditional on it holding
  RSI 1h = 37.8 -> +21 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone
  RSI daily = 30.6 -> +29 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone
  RSI divergence (1d) = bullish -> +12 (weight 1.3) - strength 35/100
  volume = 1.71x average -> +15 (weight 0.8) - Participation confirms the current move

  weighted sum / total weight (9.7) = +35.2 -> FAVORABLE
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
